bio.text: Sarah Zabel is an independent candidate for Idaho's 1st Congressional District in 2026 and a retired U.S. Air Force major general from Bayview.
According to her website, she graduated from the U.S. Air Force Academy with a computer science degree in 1987 and retired from the Air Force in 2018.

Her website says she commanded the 43rd Communications Squadron at Pope Air Force Base, the 9th Mission Support Group at Beale Air Force Base and the 75th Air Base Wing at Hill Air Force Base, and served as Vice Director of the Defense Information Systems Agency.
